title: Penniston's 'sphere of influence' near the Rendlesham craft

tellings.quote: in and around this uh what Jim penniston called a sphere of influence where he felt like he was walking through water

plain: Mike Masters, a professor who studies human origins, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a 1980 sighting in Rendlesham Forest in England, near US air bases. He says Jim Penniston, an American airman who approached a strange craft there, described a sphere of influence around it, where walking felt like moving through water. If true, it would mean the craft changed the space around it in ways people could feel.
